items.example: Coal is a common mineral.
The stove heats the whole room.

definition_zh: 海岸；海滨；（沿特定方向的）滑行
definition_en: the land beside the sea; to move without using power
core_image: 大海与陆地相遇的那条长长的线
scene: 暑假，全家坐车去看蓝色的大海。We drove to the coast for the summer holiday.
sceneCN: 这里 coast 是「海岸；海滨」（第 1 个义项：陆地与海相接的地带）；句意是我们开车去海边过暑假。

derivatives.zh: 由 coast 加后缀 -al 构成，义为「沿海的；海岸的」
由 coast 加后缀 -er 构成，义为「沿海航行船；杯垫；过山车（roller coaster）」

senses.title: The land along the sea
senses.definition: the land next to the sea
senses.definitionCN: 紧靠大海的陆地
senses.example: Fishing boats leave the coast before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 渔船天亮前就离开了海岸。
senses.why: The sea never walks inland, so where it stops, the coast begins.
senses.whyCN: 大海从不深入内陆，它停下的地方就是海岸。

senses.title: To slide without power
senses.definition: to move forward without using the engine or pedalling
senses.definitionCN: 不借助发动机或蹬踏而前进
senses.example: The bike coasted down the long hill.
senses.exampleCN: 自行车顺着长坡滑了下去。
senses.why: A sled on ice needs no push once it starts, like a boat carried by the sea.
senses.whyCN: 冰上的雪橇一旦滑动便无需再推，正如被海托着的船。

senses.title: To do something without effort
senses.definition: to progress easily without real effort
senses.definitionCN: 不费力气地顺利推进
senses.example: He coasted through the easy test.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻松通过了这场容易的考试。
senses.why: Smooth motion without pushing feels like sliding downhill, so easy work is called coasting.
senses.whyCN: 无需用力便顺利前进，如同顺坡下滑，轻松过关便叫 coasting。

intro.en: Coast began as a rib, then became a side, and finally the side of the land.
intro.cn: coast 起初是「肋骨」，后来变成「侧面」，最终成了陆地的边缘。

items.en: Latin costa meant a rib or the side of anything.
items.cn: 拉丁语 costa 指肋骨，或物体的侧面。

items.en: Old French coste kept the sense of a side or slope.
items.cn: 古法语 coste 保留「侧面；坡」的意思。

items.en: Middle English coast first meant any side or border, even of a room.
items.cn: 中古英语 coast 最初泛指任何边界，甚至房间的边。

items.en: The sea border became the main sense in Modern English.
items.cn: 现代英语中海陆边界成了主要义项。

items.en: The gliding sense grew from ships carried smoothly along the coast.
items.cn: 滑行义来自船沿海岸被海平稳地带着走。

note.en: The first group collects the coast family; the second collects seaside and slide words.
note.cn: 第一组收 coast 词族，第二组收海边与滑行类词。

entries.definition: Near or belonging to the coast.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「沿海的」，由 coast 加 -al 构成。

entries.definition: A ship sailing near the coast; a roller coaster.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「沿海船；过山车（roller coaster）」，由 coast 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: The price of something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「价格」，与 coast 仅一字母之差，词源无关。

entries.definition: The land along any water, narrower than coast.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「岸」，泛指任何水域的岸。

entries.definition: A sandy or stony seaside area.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「海滩」，指海岸的沙滩部分。

entries.definition: The coast as a holiday place.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「海边（度假地）」。

normalIntro.en: Remember coast through its rib root and its gliding ship.
normalIntro.cn: 借「肋骨」词根与顺海滑行的船记忆 coast。

normal.en: coast comes from Latin costa, a rib.
normal.cn: coast 来自拉丁语 costa（肋骨）。

normal.en: coastal means near the sea.
normal.cn: coastal 指沿海的。

normal.en: coast guard protects people at sea.
normal.cn: coast guard 保护海上的人。

normal.en: the bike coasted down the hill.
normal.cn: 自行车顺坡滑下。

normal.en: a roller coaster runs on high tracks.
normal.cn: roller coaster 在高空轨道上跑。

abstract.en: Hear soft waves folding over wet sand all afternoon.
abstract.cn: 听一下午海浪在湿沙上轻轻翻卷。

abstract.en: Feel the wind push your face as the bike rolls downhill.
abstract.cn: 感受自行车下滑时风扑在脸上。

abstract.en: See a map line where blue meets yellow.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上蓝与黄相接的那条线。

examples.en: The coast near our city has tall cliffs and cold wind.
examples.cn: 我们城市附近的海岸有高高的悬崖和冷风。

examples.en: We coasted down the hill and saved half the ride.
examples.cn: 我们顺坡滑下去，省了一半路程。

examples.en: The coast guard saved two swimmers yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天海岸警卫队救了两名游泳者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「寇斯特」——海风「寇」不去的海「斯特」（side 侧），coast 就是大陆的侧边。

root: 拉丁语 costa（肋骨；侧面）→ 古法语 coste（侧；坡）→ 中古英语 coast（边界）→ 现代英语「海岸」并引申出「滑行」；同族词有 intercostal（肋间的），派生词有 coastal（沿海的）、coaster（沿海船）。

sensesIntro.en: Coast draws the line where sea meets land, then borrows smooth sliding.
sensesIntro.cn: coast 画出海陆相接的线，又借来顺坡的滑行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the long line where the sea stops and land begins
core.cn: 核心意象：海停下、陆地开始的那条长线

intro.en: Coast sends out two simple derivatives and meets its relatives.
intro.cn: coast 派生出两个简单派生词，并会见它的亲戚们。

latinIntro.en: Latin costa, a rib, is the root hiding inside coast.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 costa（肋骨）是藏在 coast 里的词根。

items.example: The coastal town lives on fishing.
items.exampleCN: 这座沿海小镇靠捕鱼为生。

items.meaning: a coasting ship; a roller coaster
items.example: The old coaster carried timber.
Intercostal muscles help breathing.
Crabs hide along the shore.
We built castles on the beach.
The seaside town is busy in July.
items.exampleCN: 七月的海边小镇很热闹。

items.example: The slope was too steep to cycle.
Swans glide across the lake.

definition_zh: 外套；大衣；（动物的）皮毛；涂层；覆盖
definition_en: a piece of clothing worn outdoors over other clothes; a layer covering a surface
core_image: 套在最外面挡风的那件大衣
scene: 降温了，出门前妈妈给妹妹披上厚外套。Put on your coat before you go out to play.
sceneCN: 这里 coat 是「外套；大衣」（第 1 个义项：穿在最外层的保暖衣物）；句意是出去玩之前先穿上外套。

derivatives.zh: 由 over 加 coat 构成，义为「大衣；外套」
由 rain 加 coat 构成，义为「雨衣」
由 coat 加 -ing 构成，义为「涂层；覆盖层」

senses.title: Outer clothing worn outdoors
senses.definition: a garment with sleeves worn over other clothes outside
senses.definitionCN: 穿在其他衣物外面、有袖的外衣
senses.example: His coat pockets are full of chestnuts.
senses.exampleCN: 他的大衣口袋装满了栗子。
senses.why: What covers the body from weather is a covering, and the covering word named the garment.
senses.whyCN: 为身体挡风遮雨的就是「覆盖物」，覆盖之名给了这件衣裳。

senses.title: The fur or wool covering an animal
senses.definition: the natural covering of fur or hair on an animal
senses.definitionCN: 动物天然覆盖的毛皮
senses.example: The dog grows a thick coat before winter.
senses.exampleCN: 入冬前狗会长出厚厚的毛。
senses.why: Animals wear their fur like a garment, so the clothing word fit them too.
senses.whyCN: 动物披着毛皮像穿衣服，衣裳之名便也合用。

senses.title: A thin layer covering a surface
senses.definition: a thin layer of paint, dust or medicine on a surface
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖在表面的一薄层漆、灰尘或药物
senses.example: Two coats of paint made the wall bright.
senses.exampleCN: 刷了两层漆，墙变亮了。
senses.why: A painted layer lies over the wall the way a coat lies over the body.
senses.whyCN: 漆层覆在墙上，就像外套覆在身上。

senses.title: To cover with a layer
senses.definition: to form a layer over something
senses.definitionCN: 在某物上形成一层
senses.example: Frost coated the window last night.
senses.exampleCN: 昨夜窗上结了霜。
senses.why: When a thing gets its own covering, the covering name turns into a verb.
senses.whyCN: 当某物获得自己的覆盖层，覆盖之名便成了动词。

intro.en: Coat is a borrowed robe: the word rode from Rome to the farmyard.
intro.cn: coat 是件借来的袍子：这个词从罗马一路骑到了农家院。

items.en: Latin cotta was a common outer garment of farmers and soldiers.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cotta 是农夫和士兵常穿的外衣。

items.en: Old French cote carried the garment into western Europe.
items.cn: 古法语 cote 把这件衣裳带进西欧。

items.en: Middle English cote meant the outer garment of ordinary people.
items.cn: 中古英语 cote 指普通人的外衣。

items.en: Modern English kept coat for outdoor wear and stretched it to fur and paint.
items.cn: 现代英语保留 coat 指外套，并延伸到皮毛与漆层。

items.en: Compounds like raincoat and overcoat built a weather-proof family.
items.cn: raincoat、overcoat 等复合词构成防风雨词族。

note.en: The first group collects look-alike words; the second collects covering words.
note.cn: 第一组收形近词，第二组收覆盖类词。

entries.definition: A long warm coat for winter.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大衣」，由 over 加 coat 构成。

entries.definition: A waterproof coat for rain.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「雨衣」，由 rain 加 coat 构成。

entries.definition: A farm animal with horns.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「山羊」，拼写与 coat 仅一字母之差，词源无关。

entries.definition: A short coat worn on the upper body.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「夹克」，比大衣短。

entries.definition: The soft hair of an animal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「毛皮」，与 coat 第 2 义项相近。

entries.definition: One sheet of material over another.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「层」，与 coat 第 3 义项相近。

normalIntro.en: Remember coat through its covering job: bodies, animals and walls.
normalIntro.cn: 从「覆盖」的职责记忆 coat：身体、动物与墙。

normal.en: coat covers the body; a coat of paint covers the wall.
normal.cn: coat 覆盖身体，a coat of paint 覆盖墙。

normal.en: raincoat keeps rain away.
normal.cn: raincoat 挡雨。

normal.en: a dog's coat grows thick in winter.
normal.cn: 狗的皮毛冬天变厚。

normal.en: two coats of paint look brighter.
normal.cn: 刷两层漆更亮。

normal.en: coat and goat differ by one letter.
normal.cn: coat 与 goat 只差一个字母。

abstract.en: Feel the cold wind slide off your shoulders, not through.
abstract.cn: 感受冷风从肩头滑开而钻不进去。

abstract.en: See a cat lick its smooth grey fur shiny.
abstract.cn: 想象猫把自己灰色的毛舔得发亮。

abstract.en: Watch fresh white paint hide the old grey wall.
abstract.cn: 看新刷的白漆盖住旧灰墙。

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hook behind the door.
examples.cn: 把外套挂在门后的挂钩上。

examples.en: The cat's coat turned thicker as autumn came.
examples.cn: 秋天一来，猫的毛变厚了。

examples.en: One more coat of paint and the fence is done.
examples.cn: 再刷一层漆，栅栏就完工了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「寇特」——出门「寇」风冷，快穿上大衣「特」暖和，coat 就是挡风的那件衣。

root: 拉丁语 cotta（粗布外衣）→ 古法语 cote → 中古英语 cote（外衣）→ 现代英语 coat（外套、皮毛、涂层）；派生词有 overcoat（大衣）、raincoat（雨衣）、coating（涂层）。

sensesIntro.en: Coat wraps bodies, animals and walls in one covering idea.
sensesIntro.cn: coat 用一个「覆盖」意念包裹身体、动物与墙面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a layer laid on top for protection
core.cn: 核心意象：为保护而盖在上面的一层

intro.en: Coat builds a weather-proof compound family.
intro.cn: coat 构造出防风雨的复合词族。

latinIntro.en: Coat is a Latin garment word via French, but its compounds are English-made.
latinIntro.cn: coat 经法语借自拉丁衣物词，复合词则由英语自造。

items.example: He bought a grey overcoat.
Fold the raincoat after school.

items.meaning: a layer spread on a surface
items.example: A thin coating of ice covered the road.
A topcoat is enough in autumn.
The jacket has four pockets.
The rabbit's fur is white.
Add a second layer of glue.

items.meaning: a sugar layer on a cake
items.example: The frosting melted in the sun.

latinEntries.meaning: an outer garment of common people

definition_zh: 咖啡；咖啡豆；咖啡色
definition_en: a hot drink made from roasted beans; the beans themselves
core_image: 一只冒着热气的杯子，深色的液体上有细细的白汽
scene: 冬天的早晨，爸爸端着热腾腾的杯子走进厨房。Dad drinks a cup of coffee before going to work.
sceneCN: 这里 coffee 是「咖啡」（第 1 个义项：用咖啡豆冲泡的热饮）；句意是爸爸上班前喝一杯咖啡。

derivatives.zh: 由 coffee 加 house 构成，义为「咖啡馆」
源自法语，义为「咖啡馆；小餐馆」

senses.title: The hot drink
senses.definition: a hot brown drink made from roasted and ground beans
senses.definitionCN: 用烘烤研磨的豆子冲出的棕色热饮
senses.example: Hot coffee smells best on a cold morning.
senses.exampleCN: 冷天早晨的热咖啡闻起来最香。
senses.why: Boiling water poured on ground roasted beans gives a dark drink that wakes the body up.
senses.whyCN: 沸水冲过烘焙研磨的豆子，便得到提神的深色饮品。

senses.title: The beans or powder
senses.definition: the roasted beans or the powder made from them
senses.definitionCN: 烘焙过的豆子或研磨成的粉
senses.example: Grandma buys coffee beans from the southern farm.
senses.exampleCN: 奶奶从南方农场买咖啡豆。
senses.why: The drink is named after the stuff it comes from, so beans and powder share the name.
senses.whyCN: 饮品以原料得名，豆子与粉便共享这个名字。

senses.title: A cup of coffee as a social event
senses.definition: an occasion of sitting together and drinking coffee
senses.definitionCN: 坐在一起喝咖啡的场合
senses.example: Let's have a coffee after the match.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛结束后我们去喝杯咖啡吧。
senses.why: The drink became so friendly that the cup turned into an appointment.
senses.whyCN: 这种饮品太有社交气质，一杯咖啡便成了一场约会。

intro.en: Coffee crossed the world in a cup: from Ethiopia through Arabia and Turkey into Europe.
intro.cn: 咖啡装在杯子里跨越世界：从埃塞俄比亚经阿拉伯、土耳其进入欧洲。

items.en: Arabic qahwah first named the wine-like dark drink.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 qahwah 最初指这种像酒一样的深色饮品。

items.en: Turkish kahve passed the word north-west with the drink itself.
items.cn: 土耳其语 kahve 带着这种饮品把词传向西北。

items.en: Italian caffe softened the sound for European ears.
items.cn: 意大利语 caffe 让发音更柔和，以适应欧洲人的耳朵。

items.en: English took coffee in the seventeenth century when coffeehouses spread.
items.cn: 十七世纪咖啡馆盛行时，英语借入了 coffee。

items.en: Modern English added coffee shop, coffee break and instant coffee.
items.cn: 现代英语又添了 coffee shop、coffee break、instant coffee 等词。

note.en: The first group collects look-alike words; the second collects drink words.
note.cn: 第一组收形近词，第二组收饮品类词。

entries.definition: A place that serves coffee.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「咖啡馆」，由 coffee 加 house 构成。

entries.definition: A hard sweet made from sugar and butter.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「太妃糖」，拼写与 coffee 相近但词源无关。

entries.definition: A small restaurant serving coffee.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「咖啡馆」，源自同一法语链条。

entries.definition: A hot drink made from dried leaves.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「茶」，用干茶叶冲泡。

entries.definition: A hot drink made from cacao powder.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「可可」，用可可粉冲泡。

entries.definition: A small strong cup of coffee.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「浓缩咖啡」，量小而浓。

normalIntro.en: Remember coffee through its long journey and its warm cup.
normalIntro.cn: 沿着漫长的旅程与温暖的杯子记忆 coffee。

normal.en: coffee travelled from Arabic qahwah to English.
normal.cn: coffee 从阿拉伯语 qahwah 一路走到英语。

normal.en: black coffee has no milk in it.
normal.cn: black coffee 不加奶。

normal.en: instant coffee mixes fast in hot water.
normal.cn: instant coffee 在热水里很快化开。

normal.en: a coffee break is a short rest at work.
normal.cn: coffee break 是工作间隙的小憩。

normal.en: the plural coffees means cups of it.
normal.cn: coffees 指一杯杯咖啡。

abstract.en: Hear the soft drip of the coffee pot early in the morning.
abstract.cn: 听清晨咖啡壶轻轻的滴答声。

abstract.en: Feel the warm cup pass from one hand to a friend's.
abstract.cn: 感受暖杯从一只手递到朋友手里。

abstract.en: See two friends talking till the cups run empty.
abstract.cn: 想象两位朋友聊到杯底见空。

examples.en: Mom made three coffees for the guests last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚妈妈为客人做了三杯咖啡。

examples.en: The coffee shop near school sells milk tea too.
examples.cn: 学校附近的咖啡店也卖奶茶。

examples.en: Two spoons of coffee powder made the kitchen smell rich.
examples.cn: 两勺咖啡粉让厨房满是香气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「咖啡」——苦香扑鼻，人们喝了都说「咖啡！咖啡！」，coffee 就是这杯深色热饮。

root: 阿拉伯语 qahwah（深色饮品）→ 土耳其语 kahve → 意大利语 caffe → 十七世纪英语 coffee；同源词有 cafe（咖啡馆），派生词有 coffeehouse（咖啡馆）。

sensesIntro.en: Coffee names the drink, the beans and the friendly break it creates.
sensesIntro.cn: coffee 指饮品、豆子，也指它带来的社交时光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: warm dark steam rising from a small cup
core.cn: 核心意象：小杯中升起温热的深色蒸汽

intro.en: Coffee builds cozy compounds of cups and houses.
intro.cn: coffee 构造出杯子与屋子的温馨复合词。

latinIntro.en: Coffee is Arabic in origin, so Latin relatives are absent.
latinIntro.cn: coffee 源自阿拉伯语，没有拉丁同族词。

items.example: The old coffeehouse opened in 1900.
We ate lunch at the corner cafe.
items.exampleCN: 我们在街角小馆吃午饭。

items.meaning: strong coffee in a small cup
items.example: One espresso kept him awake.
items.exampleCN: 一杯浓缩咖啡让他保持清醒。

items.example: Green tea smells fresh.
Hot cocoa warms the winter.
She ordered an iced mocha.

items.meaning: a person making coffee in a cafe
items.example: The barista drew a heart on it.
items.exampleCN: 咖啡师在上面画了颗心。

items.example: Instant noodles save time.

definition_zh: 硬币；铸币；发明（新词）
definition_en: a small flat piece of metal money; to invent a new word or phrase
core_image: 口袋里一枚凉凉的、叮当作响的小圆金属片
scene: 公交车上，妹妹从钱包里摸出一枚圆圆的金属币投进票箱。She dropped a coin into the fare box.
sceneCN: 这里 coin 是「硬币」（第 1 个义项：金属铸造的钱币）；句意是她把一枚硬币投进了票箱。

collocations.phrase: the other side of the coin

derivatives.zh: 由 coin 加后缀 -age 构成，义为「造币；新造词」
coin 的过去分词形式，义为「新造的」

senses.title: A flat piece of metal money
senses.definition: a small flat round piece of metal used as money
senses.definitionCN: 用作货币的小圆金属片
senses.example: I found an old coin under the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 我在桌子底下发现一枚旧硬币。
senses.why: Metal stamped with a picture holds value like paper, but it rings and never tears.
senses.whyCN: 印有图案的金属像纸一样承载价值，却能叮当作响、永不撕破。

senses.title: To make metal money
senses.definition: to make pieces of metal money in a mint
senses.definitionCN: 在造币厂制造金属货币
senses.example: The mint coins millions every year.
senses.exampleCN: 造币厂每年铸造数百万枚硬币。
senses.why: The thing and the making of it share one word, as the factory gives its name to the action.
senses.whyCN: 物与造物共用一词，工厂的名字也给了动作。

senses.title: To invent a new word or phrase
senses.definition: to make and use a word or phrase for the first time
senses.definitionCN: 首次造出并使用某个词或短语
senses.example: Students coined a funny name for the school rabbit.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们给学校的兔子起了个有趣的新名字。
senses.why: A fresh word is struck like fresh money: new, shining and ready to spend.
senses.whyCN: 新词像新币一样被铸造出来：崭新、闪亮、随时流通。

intro.en: Coin was stamped in the French mint and passed to English with its ring.
intro.cn: coin 在法国造币厂铸成，带着清脆的响声传进英语。

items.en: Latin cuneus meant a wedge, the tool used to stamp metal.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cuneus 意为楔子，即打制金属的工具。

items.en: Old French coin named the wedge, the stamp and then the stamped piece.
items.cn: 古法语 coin 既指楔子和印模，也指印出来的钱币。

items.en: Middle English coin settled as the little stamped metal money.
items.cn: 中古英语 coin 定型为小小的印制金属钱币。

items.en: The verb grew: to coin money, and later to coin words.
items.cn: 动词义随之生长：铸造钱币，进而铸造词语。

items.en: Modern English keeps the coin flip for chance decisions.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了抛硬币定夺的用法。

note.en: The first group collects look-alike words; the second collects money words.
note.cn: 第一组收形近词，第二组收货币类词。

entries.definition: The making of coins; new words.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「造币；新造词」，由 coin 加 -age 构成。

entries.definition: Grain plants such as wheat.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「谷物」，拼写与 coin 相近但词源不同。

entries.definition: To bring together.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「加入；连接」，拼写与 coin 相近但词源无关。

entries.definition: Paper money.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「纸币」，与硬币相对。

entries.definition: Money in notes and coins.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「现金」，统称钱钞。

entries.definition: The money used in a country.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「通货；货币」。

normalIntro.en: Remember coin through its mint ring and its word-making power.
normalIntro.cn: 从造币的响声与造词的能力记忆 coin。

normal.en: coin comes from a Latin word for wedge.
normal.cn: coin 来自拉丁语「楔子」一词。

normal.en: flip a coin to decide by chance.
normal.cn: flip a coin 指抛硬币碰运气。

normal.en: coin a phrase means invent new words.
normal.cn: coin a phrase 指创造新词。

normal.en: the other side of the coin means the other view.
normal.cn: 「the other side of the coin」指事情的另一面。

normal.en: notes are paper; coins are metal.
normal.cn: note 是纸币，coin 是硬币。

abstract.en: Hear the small silver ring of a coin on the floor.
abstract.cn: 听硬币落地的清脆银响。

abstract.en: Feel the ridged edge roll under your thumb.
abstract.cn: 感受拇指下滚动的锯齿边。

abstract.en: See a brand-new word sparkle like fresh metal.
abstract.cn: 想象一个新词像新铸的金属般闪亮。

examples.en: He kept every coin from his school trips.
examples.cn: 他保存着学校旅行攒下的每一枚硬币。

examples.en: They flipped a coin to choose who goes first.
examples.cn: 他们抛硬币决定谁先来。

examples.en: Gamers coined a word for that tricky move last year.
examples.cn: 去年游戏玩家们为那个高难度动作造了个新词。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「寇因」——因小硬币上刻着王冠（crown 谐音寇），coin 就是带着印记的钱。

root: 拉丁语 cuneus（楔子）→ 古法语 coin（印模；钱币）→ 中古英语 coin（硬币）→ 现代英语 coin（硬币、铸币、创造新词）；派生词有 coinage（造币；新造词）。

sensesIntro.en: Coin rings as metal money and stamps out fresh words.
sensesIntro.cn: coin 既是叮当作响的金属货币，也铸出崭新的词语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: metal stamped into small shining value
core.cn: 核心意象：被印模压成闪亮小片价值的金属

intro.en: Coin builds a money-shaped little family.
intro.cn: coin 构造出一个钱币形状的小词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root cuneus, a wedge, also lives in cuneiform.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 cuneus（楔子）也存在于 cuneiform（楔形文字）中。

items.example: That word is a recent coinage.
Clay tablets keep cuneiform signs.
items.exampleCN: 泥板上保留着楔形文字。

items.example: The leaf is cuneate at the base.
I paid with a ten-yuan note.
Pay cash and keep the receipt.
The yen is Japanese currency.
The mint stamps new coins.

items.meaning: to throw up for a choice
items.example: Toss the coin and call heads.

definition_zh: 冷的；寒冷的；冷淡的；感冒；寒冷
definition_en: low in temperature; unfriendly in manner; a common illness of the nose and throat
core_image: 冬天推开家门时扑面的那阵凉气
scene: 早操时，操场上呼出的气都变成了白雾。The morning wind felt cold on my face.
sceneCN: 这里 cold 是「冷的；寒冷的」（第 1 个义项：温度低）；句意是早晨的风吹在脸上很冷。

derivatives.zh: 由 cold 加后缀 -ly 构成，义为「冷淡地；冷冷地」
由 cold 加后缀 -ness 构成，义为「寒冷；冷淡」

senses.title: Low in temperature
senses.definition: having a low temperature
senses.definitionCN: 温度低的
senses.example: Cold milk tastes best after running.
senses.exampleCN: 跑完步喝冷牛奶最舒服。
senses.why: Heat leaves the body or the room, and what remains is the feeling we call cold.
senses.whyCN: 热量离开身体或房间，剩下的感觉便是冷。

senses.title: Unfriendly in manner
senses.definition: showing no kindness or warmth of feeling
senses.definitionCN: 表现出没有善意或热情
senses.example: She gave the new boy a cold look.
senses.exampleCN: 她冷冷地看了新来的男孩一眼。
senses.why: A cold room makes people withdraw, and so does a cold face.
senses.whyCN: 冰冷的房间让人退缩，冰冷的表情也是。

senses.title: A common nose and throat illness
senses.definition: a mild illness with sneezing and a runny nose
senses.definitionCN: 打喷嚏、流鼻涕的轻度疾病
senses.example: I caught a cold after the rainy match.
senses.exampleCN: 雨中的比赛后我感冒了。
senses.why: Old medicine blamed the chill for the sniffles, so the illness took the temperature's name.
senses.whyCN: 旧时医学把打喷嚏归咎于受寒，这种病便借用了温度的名字。

senses.title: The state of low temperature
senses.definition: the condition of being cold, or cold weather
senses.definitionCN: 温度低的状态或寒冷天气
senses.example: Do not stay out in the cold too long.
senses.exampleCN: 别在寒冷的户外待太久。
senses.why: The adjective turns into a noun for the weather itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转指天气本身的寒冷。

intro.en: Cold is one of the oldest weather words, carried in English from the very start.
intro.cn: cold 是最古老的天气词之一，从英语诞生之初便被携带。

items.en: The Germanic base *kaldaz meant cool or cold.
items.cn: 日耳曼词基 *kaldaz 意为凉或冷。

items.en: Old English ceald covered both weather and feelings.
items.cn: 古英语 ceald 既指天气也指情感。

items.en: German kalt and Dutch koud are cousins from the same base.
items.cn: 德语 kalt 与荷兰语 koud 是同一词基的亲戚。

items.en: Middle English cold gained the illness sense for the common sniffles.
items.cn: 中古英语 cold 获得了感冒这一义项。

items.en: Modern English uses cold for weather, feelings, food and illness alike.
items.cn: 现代英语的 cold 同时用于天气、情感、食物与疾病。

note.en: The first group collects the cold family; the second collects temperature words.
note.cn: 第一组收 cold 词族，第二组收温度类词。

entries.definition: The state of being cold.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「寒冷；冷淡」，由 cold 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: In an unfriendly way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「冷淡地」，由 cold 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: A thin rope or wire.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「绳；电线」，拼写与 cold 相近但词源无关。

entries.definition: A little cold, often pleasant.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「凉的」，程度较轻。

entries.definition: Very cold, at or below zero.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「极冷的」，程度更深。

entries.definition: Unpleasantly cold.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「寒意袭人的」。

normalIntro.en: Remember cold through winter wind, cold eyes and runny noses.
normalIntro.cn: 从冬风、冷眼与鼻涕三面记忆 cold。

normal.en: cold, colder, coldest compare temperatures.
normal.cn: cold、colder、coldest 比较温度。

normal.en: catch a cold means get the sniffles.
normal.cn: catch a cold 指得感冒。

normal.en: a cold look shows no friendliness.
normal.cn: cold look 表示不友好。

normal.en: German kalt sounds like cold.
normal.cn: 德语 kalt 读起来像 cold。

normal.en: coldly is cold plus -ly.
normal.cn: coldly 是 cold 加 -ly。

abstract.en: Feel the first icy step onto the winter floor.
abstract.cn: 感受冬天早晨踩上冰凉地板的第一步。

abstract.en: Hear wind press the window all night long.
abstract.cn: 听风整夜压着窗户。

abstract.en: See a turned shoulder ending a conversation.
abstract.cn: 想象一个转过去的肩膀结束了对话。

examples.en: The water was too cold, so we swam fast and got out.
examples.cn: 水太冷了，我们游得飞快就上了岸。

examples.en: A cold made her miss two days of school.
examples.cn: 一场感冒让她缺了两天课。

examples.en: The coach gave us a cold answer to our plan.
examples.cn: 教练对我们的计划给了个冷冷的答复。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「寇的」——寒风「寇」入门，被冻「的」直哆嗦，cold 就是透骨的冷。

root: 日耳曼语 *kaldaz（冷）→ 古英语 ceald → 中古英语 cold → 现代英语 cold（冷的、冷淡的、感冒）；同族词有德语 kalt，派生词有 coldly（冷淡地）、coldness（寒冷）。

sensesIntro.en: Cold measures temperature, cools manners, names an illness and a season.
sensesIntro.cn: cold 既量温度，也冷待人，还指感冒与寒天。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: heat gone away, leaving only chill
core.cn: 核心意象：热量离去，只剩寒意

intro.en: Cold builds weather and manner words with plain English endings.
intro.cn: cold 用朴素的英语词缀构造天气与态度类词。

latinIntro.en: Cold is Germanic, so Latin relatives are absent from this family.
latinIntro.cn: cold 属日耳曼词源，家族中没有拉丁亲戚。

items.example: He answered coldly and left.
items.exampleCN: 他冷冷地答了一句便离开。

items.example: The coldness of the reply surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 答复的冷淡让我们吃惊。

items.example: Winter is colder than autumn.
January is the coldest month.
The evening is cool and clear.
Freezing nights froze the pond.
A chilly wind entered the room.

items.meaningCN: 德语「冷」，与 cold 同源
items.example: German kalt rhymes with old.
items.exampleCN: 德语 kalt 与 old 押韵。
